name: Geyserland Classic
description: A three-day Rotorua loop linking lakes, quiet backroads, the coast and geothermal country.
text1: Erik Westra runs the Geyserland Classic as a friendly annual bikepacking event, alongside the shorter Geyserland Mini and the much larger Geyserland Mega. Join the event for the shared experience, or ride the publicly accessible route independently at any time of year.
text2:
The Geyserland Classic is a 235 km loop from Rotorua to Matatā, returning through Rerewhakaaitu, Waikite Valley and the Te Ara Ahi cycleway. Expect quiet backroads, rolling gravel, lakes and plenty of climbing.
The riding is mostly non-technical but the remoteness and long gaps between services make it a proper bikepacking challenge. Ride it over three relaxed days or a more demanding overnighter.
text3:
Rotorua is the natural start and finish, with plenty of accommodation and shops. Sneak in a couple of mountainbiking laps in the redwoods while you are in town - the trails are world class.
Resupply is available in Matatā, Te Teko and Waiotapu, but there is no reliable water between Te Teko and Rerewhakaaitu.
